item.title: Morning Brief — Saturday, August 29, 2026
item.description: Today's three: One. If you're building multi-agent, route through a supervisor and cap the fan-out. Two. Whether it's Cowork or a full Company OS, start by scoring what your agent actually knows. Three. Deep tech money is moving fast, and fast money is the money that skips diligence.

item.title: Morning Brief — Friday, August 28, 2026
item.description: Today's three: Two. Break into AI PM work by shipping your own AI project and calling it what it is. Work. Three. Point AI at your contracts, and match your marketing to whether people chase gains or fear losses.

item.title: Morning Brief — Thursday, August 27, 2026
item.description: Today's three: One. Taste is trained, so protect the setups that grow it. Two. Feed your AI both frozen knowledge and living context. Three. Ask your agents for decisions, not status updates.
